title: Resonance Terminal
text: Obtained through the Resonance Ritual, a terminal binds four nodes placed above containers. Select a link to open the container's own interface. Removed nodes are unbound automatically.

A successful opening costs half your maximum mana, unaffected by reductions. Insufficient mana or a container without an interface prevents opening without charging. Transfers cost nothing extra. Create vaults and tanks have no interface but still support logistics.

A terminal cannot bind the same complete container twice. If two bound resonant orbs successfully join one network, only the earlier link remains. Splitting the network does not restore it; bind again. Separate terminals may access the same container.
